candidates.instruction: In `iterative_divider_core`, change `iteration_count` from an up-counter to a down-counter: load `WIDTH - 1` on accepted capture, decrement on each busy compute edge, and finish when the pre-edge count is zero. Keep the existing arithmetic step, result registers, handshake and reset behavior unchanged; preserve the supported `WIDTH` range, including `WIDTH=1`. Retain the candidate only if all gates pass and routed LUT use is strictly below the 27-LUT incumbent.
